narrative.overview: espublicar is a marketplace between strangers, so its whole job is to make a stranger feel safe. It reads like a clean, well-lit local shop: familiar layout, honest photos, prices you can trust. Warmth comes from clarity and spacing, not decoration. Blue is the badge of safety and earns its saturation by being scarce. A product system: comfortable mobile-first density on a 4px rhythm, real photography leading, chrome quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Trust rendered as UI (secure-pay, tracked-shipping, ratings), not slogans
One scarce brand blue for action + safety; neutrals do the rest
Comfortable, mobile-first density on a 4px rhythm
Real product photography is the hero; chrome stays quiet

rules.name: The Scarce Blue Rule
rules.body: Trust Blue covers <=10% of any screen; its rarity makes it read as safe action, not decoration.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text is Ink or Ink Muted, never Ink Soft (#64748B) on a tinted surface; light-gray-for-elegance is forbidden.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only; hierarchy is weight + size + color, never a second face.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Prices use tabular-nums so columns of euro align; misaligned prices read as sloppy, and sloppy reads as scam.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Depth is a response, not a default; a card earns a shadow by hover or floating.

dos: Do keep Trust Blue (#2563EB) scarce - actions and trust signals only, <=10% of a screen.
Do render trust as UI: secure-payment, tracked-shipping, ratings, Negociable badges.
Do use Ink (#0F172A) / Ink Muted (#334155) for all body text; verify >=4.5:1.
Do give every interactive element a visible :focus-visible outline and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do lead with real product photography; let images carry the color.
Do use tabular numerals for every price.
Do design mobile-first - large tap targets, bottom-reachable primary actions.
donts: Don't ship the generic SaaS template - no gradient hero, no wall of identical icon cards, no eyebrow above every section.
Don't use gradient text or glassmorphism as decoration.
Don't drift toward a luxury boutique - no hairline high-fashion minimalism.
Don't go cold corporate/bank - no grey enterprise stiffness, no form-first screens.
Don't become cheap spammy classifieds - no ad clutter, no low-contrast gray body, no cramped listings.
Don't add a second font family, side-stripe borders, or 01/02/03 markers on non-sequential sections.
